items.q: Louis Armstrong. Red Allen. We all played together.

ctx.x: Stop it Paul, she can't fix it. Okay. Alright. What's your name? My name is Joseph. That's not what everybody calls you. They call me Kid Twat from the Boothwaite.

Well where the Boothwaite come from? I was up in St. Paul, Minnesota. I left there. I came on down there to St. Louis. Where I was then. They used me. I was taken right from my own hometown. And then what they call me then? Kid Twat from the Boothwaite. Why they call me that? Because I was a cigarette tester. Cigarette tester. Where were you born?
